title: Q-AUDIT-cost-runaway: fm-cost-runaway failing (fail): Read the latest ops/cost.jsonl row: fix the probe if unmeasured, otherwise cut the largest spender (model route, read pattern) by PR
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe cost-runaway
**Status:** closed

Failure mode `fm-cost-runaway` detected by `cost-runaway`, failing since 2026-11-26T16:03:00Z.
Evidence: latest cost reading measured no D1 database (rows read and size unknown)
cost level 0.805 of budget is at or above warn_level 0.8

Signature: 72cf40d9a32e (disposition: fix).
Suspected root cause: the cost reading stopped, was unmeasured, or a free-plan limit is near
Remedy: Read the latest ops/cost.jsonl row: fix the probe if unmeasured, otherwise cut the largest spender (model route, read pattern) by PR
Fix the earliest cause, so the detector passes; do not weaken or remove the detector.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe cost-runaway

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T22:05:16Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
